message.content: Let me check if there's a simpler way - maybe there's a standalone test program or the fuzzer can be compiled standalone:

trap ctrl_c INT

ctrl_c() {
  ./${fuzzer} -merge=1 ${fuzzer}.in ${fuzzer}.new
  rm -rf ${fuzzer}.new
}

if test -z "$1"; then
        echo "Usage: $0 <fuzzer target>"
        echo "Example: $0 libidn2_to_ascii_8z_fuzzer"
        exit 1
fi

fuzzer=$1
workers=$(($(nproc) - 1))
jobs=$workers

clang-6.0 \
 $CFLAGS -Og -g -I../include -I.. \
 ${fuzzer}.c -o ${fuzzer} \
 -Wl,-Bstatic ../lib/.libs/libidn2.a -lFuzzer \
 -lunistring \
 -Wl,-Bdynamic -lclang-6.0 -lstdc++

if test -n "$BUILD_ONLY"; then
  exit 0
fi

# create directory for NEW test corpora (covering new areas of code)
mkdir -p ${fuzzer}.new

if test -f ${fuzzer}.dict; then
  ./${fuzzer} -dict=${fuzzer}.dict ${fuzzer}.new ${fuzzer}.in -jobs=$jobs -workers=$workers
else
  ./${fuzzer} ${fuzzer}.new ${fuzzer}.in -jobs=$jobs -workers=$workers
fi

exit 0
